purpose: Four complete collectible card face concepts for user style selection; not integrated into card pool
historicalNote: Creative sword designs inspired by legendary Chun Jun; not artifact reconstructions

concepts.label: 青铜礼器
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept / collectible card design. Design ONE complete premium Chinese legendary sword collectible CARD FACE, straight-on flat artwork, full-bleed portrait 5:7, 1060 x 1484 if possible. The requested deliverable is primarily THE CARD DESIGN, not a standalone weapon illustration: the designed frame, corner treatments, title area, subtle series branding, typography hierarchy, material finishes and central illustration must form a polished coherent finished collectible card. The card fills the ENTIRE image; no hand holding it, no tabletop, no outside mockup margin, no multiple cards, no concept sheet. Theme is the legendary sword CHUN JUN (纯钧), a creative interpretation rather than a historical artifact reconstruction. Main visual is ONE beautiful ancient Chinese straight double-edged sword, no person, no European cruciform crossguard, no katana. A slender symmetrical bronze jian with small elegant guard, circular pommel, dark diamond-inlay blade pattern, restrained turquoise or jade detail. Sword must be large and legible at thumbnail size. Use EXACT Chinese text: title "纯钧" prominent in its own thoughtfully designed lower title zone; small series label "名剑录" at the top. Small English "CHUN JUN" optional. No random Chinese paragraphs, no bogus stat values, no rarity stars, no game costs, no company logos, no QR code or watermark. Leave the overall art decomposable into subject and background in a future interactive 2.5D card; this output is a COMPLETE finished opaque card, no transparency. ART DIRECTION A — BRONZE RITUAL TREASURE: austere, majestic, high-craft Chinese bronze-and-jade collectible. Deep almost-black malachite green background with whisper-thin topographic cloud engravings. A rich raised antique gold/bronze frame encircles the full card, narrow enough that artwork remains spacious; nested architectural corner details based on archaic leiwen thunder patterns, small turquoise enamel inset jewels. Central sword levitates diagonally very slightly (hilt lower left, point upper right), fully visible and dominating the card, around 75% of card height. Behind it a subtle large antique jade bi disk and quiet ceremonial mist, not a circular sci-fi machine. Real bronze edge sheen, patina in recesses, gilt craftsmanship and restrained metallic foil. Title 纯钧 is exquisitely typeset gold Chinese serif/calligraphic carving in an integrated wide dark-green cartouche at the bottom, small 名剑录 engraved at top center. Muted emerald, dark teal, oxidized bronze, old gold. Dramatic directional lighting, deep shadows and tangible metal relief. Sophisticated luxury card design with an unmistakably Chinese ritual character. Not medieval European tarot border, not a generic fantasy poster.

ART DIRECTION B — CONTEMPORARY MUSEUM COLLECTOR CARD: serene, refined, cinematic museum artifact photography fused with modern Chinese editorial design. Main sword displayed upright slightly off center, pommel at top and point below, centered on a deep warm charcoal recessed exhibition niche. Highly believable aged bronze material, crisp gold-toned sharpened edges and black diamond blade pattern, subtle turquoise guard detail, full silhouette visible. A soft pool of warm light from upper left traces the blade, sparse dust particles and a dim distant silhouette of a mountain on the niche backdrop. Sophisticated wide warm ivory card border with subtle textured cotton paper, very thin bronze inner rules, elegant small corner bracket details rather than ornate gold scrollwork. Carefully composed complete trading card face, not a museum wall label and not a product photo on a table.

ART DIRECTION C — INK AND MIST POETIC COLLECTIBLE CARD: a complete Chinese ink-painting sword card on soft rice-white handmade xuan paper. Poised quiet intensity, ethereal Jiangnan mountain water, tiny distant peaks in pale blue-grey wash, mist and negative space. Central fine bronze jian floats diagonally from lower left toward upper right across the card, blade dark graphite and cold silver-gold gleam, restrained green jade hilt, clean silhouette and exceptional engraved details. One sweeping ink wash and a small vermilion silk ribbon give motion; sword and its quiet reflection nearly meet over pale water. Designed thin double-line muted-ink frame with broken/chamfered corners and subtle embossed cloud pattern details, minimalist gold-leaf highlights at four corners. Title 纯钧 appears very prominently in expressive but legible black Chinese calligraphy in a reserved lower part of card; small 名剑录 at top in elegant dark ink. A small blank cinnabar seal shape near the title, no invented seal text. Predominantly ivory, fog-grey, ink-black, jade grey and one vermilion accent. No thick western ornament, no neon, no characters or people. Sophisticated, collectible, distinctive card typography and framing — not a loose ink illustration or hanging scroll.

ART DIRECTION D — CELESTIAL CHINESE FANTASY ACHIEVEMENT CARD: dazzling high-tier collectible with layered sculptural Chinese design, midnight indigo and luminous jade-green with restrained gold foil. A central proud ancient Chinese bronze jian points UP, hilt at bottom, blade tip near upper fifth of card, whole sword visible, strong thin silhouette with a golden central ridge and dark geometric blade engraving. Behind it, a monumental stylized mountain gate suggested by swirling auspicious clouds and a fractured circular celestial jade disk; a soft emerald halo traces the sword without overwhelming it. A few delicate gold particles and ribbonlike cloud arcs suggest a sword awakening. The CARD FRAME is a major designed feature: elegant three-dimensional cut-corner octagonal Chinese lacquerwork rim, stepped bronze and gold bevels, jade inlay, subtle symmetrical dragon-cloud relief corners; bottom frame expands into a structured sculptural nameplate featuring large legible embossed gold text 纯钧. Small 名剑录 at top. Polished AAA game card illustration with painterly depth and luxury physical foil material, clearly Chinese, bold and readable at small size. No cartoon, no sci-fi UI, no generic rainbow holo noise, no excessive gems or spikes, no floating interface stats. Frame and illustration must feel designed as ONE complete collectible card.
